definition: A school where MAD runs its programme this year.
A class section with at least one active child, where volunteers mentor a small group of children.
The fixed day and time each week when a mentoring circle meets. A circle needs a slot before it can hold sessions.
A child whose every mentoring circle has a weekly slot and at least one volunteer placed in it.
Our volunteer goal: at least 1 volunteer in every mentoring circle (1:5). Minimum volunteers to start sessions = 1 for every 5 active children.
Recruited: the volunteer is listed at the chapter for this year. Assigned to a class section: they are also placed in a mentoring circle.
At least one mentoring circle at the chapter has held a session this year, with the volunteer present or a substitute.
Every mentoring circle with a slot whose first session date has passed has held at least one session this year.
A volunteer who took at least 9 in 10 of their planned sessions in the chosen period, counting from 1 Oct.

One session a week for every mentoring circle with a weekly slot since 1 Oct, whether or not a volunteer is assigned. A planned session is held, cancelled, missed by the volunteer (volunteer absent) or had no volunteer assigned that day.
